item.tib: stag la me 'bar bdag rdzogs gsang ba mchog gis skabs kyi cha lags nor bu'i gter mdzod
item.coloph: zhes stag la bdag rdzogs gsang ba mchog gis (gi) sgrub pa las/ skabs kyi cha lag nor bu'i gter mdzod zhes bya ba/ drin chen dam pa'i gsung la brten nas/ bdag rang phrug rmongs pa'i (pas) bkra shis ri khrod gnas su brtsams pa 'di/ rjes 'jug rnams dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po ru gyur cig
